name: Bumbu Restaurant
description: 坐落在甘榜格南一栋娘惹风格老店屋里，以正宗娘惹(土生华人)料理为主，融合泰式与印尼风味。店内装潢充满浓郁的南洋复古怀旧气息与精美木雕艺术，大部分菜品人均不到20新币，性价比高，深受本地人与游客喜爱。
descriptionEn: Housed in a heritage Peranakan shophouse in Kampong Glam, serving authentic Nyonya (Peranakan) cuisine fused with Thai and Indonesian flavors. The interior features rich vintage Baba-Nyonya decor and exquisite wood carvings. Most dishes are under S$20, offering great value for locals and visitors alike.
openingHoursEn: 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM, 6:00 PM - 10:00 PM (Closed on Mondays)
recommendNote: 招牌娘惹黑果鸡（Buah Keluak）和娘惹杂菜值得一试，复古南洋木雕装潢非常出片。
recommendNoteEn: The Signature Buah Keluak chicken and Nonya Chapchye are must-tries. The vintage wood-carved decor is great for photos.

restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficultyEn: Recommended to book 1-3 days in advance
